llm_response.reason: The website is a phishing copy of the legitimate Codashop service, hosted on an unaffiliated and newly registered subdomain (ferna.web.id, created 2025-02-26). The page copies content, links, and payment options from Codashop but is not on the official domain. This is a classic example of a site attempting to deceive users into entering credentials or making payments to a fraudulent operator by impersonating a trusted brand. Key scam indicators include domain spoofing, use of the real company's content with none of their infrastructure, promotional/guarantee language, ambiguous ownership/contact info, and recency of domain registration.
